It cannot promise a synced full-history target.

download_and_time_uncertainty.reindex_need: A fresh datadir avoids existing-node reindex. A pruned source cannot satisfy txindex; later enabling txindex requires a retained-history index build. Never point at or reindex an existing node.

watchdog_and_clean_stop.deadline_handling: Stop on the first disk/download/time/memory/identity/expiry limit. Polling permits transient overshoot/compaction; these are supervisor stop thresholds, not atomic filesystem quotas. Foreign writers are unbounded. Retain stopping margin; if strict allocation guarantees are required, an assigned quota/volume is a separate prerequisite.
watchdog_and_clean_stop.method: Record exact owned PID, executable, datadir, ports and cookie path in private ledger. Prefer owner-cookie stop; after exact ownership verification SIGTERM is fallback. Wait up to120 seconds for exit/flush. Do not automatically SIGKILL, restart or retry if shutdown is ambiguous.
watchdog_and_clean_stop.preserve: Retain partial datadir, counters, logs and checkpoints. No deletion, wallet reuse, pruning, expiry bypass or automatic resumption. Report the stop reason before another decision.
watchdog_and_clean_stop.ownership: Do not stop/change any foreign node, process, datadir, device or Metro port.

Default expiry uses selected network upgrade time, with an earlier Chipnet date. Overrides are not compatibility fixes. The same source rejects pruning with txindex.
